using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using Moq.Protected;
using OpenRA;
using OpenRA.FileSystem;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Tests.Map
{
	public class MapPreviewTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_DoesNotCallHttpClient_WhenStatusIsNotDownloadErrorOrDownloadAvailable()
		{
			var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
			var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>(MockBehavior.Strict);
			var mockMapInstallPackage = new Mock<IReadWritePackage>();

			var mapPreview = new MapPreview(
				"test-uid",
				mockModData.Object,
				mockCache.Object,
				MapStatus.Available,
				MapClassification.User,
				null,
				null);

			var httpClientFactoryMock = new Mock<HttpClientFactory>();
			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => httpClientFactoryMock.Object;

			try
			{
				await mapPreview.Install("http://test-repo/");
				Assert.Equal(MapStatus.Available, mapPreview.Status);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_DoesNotCallHttpClient_WhenMapInstallDirectoryNotFound()
		{
			var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
			mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(new Dictionary<string, MapClassification>());

			var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>();
			var mapPreview = new MapPreview(
				"test-uid",
				mockModData.Object,
				mockCache.Object,
				MapStatus.DownloadAvailable,
				MapClassification.User,
				null,
				null);

			await mapPreview.Install("http://test-repo/");
			Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, mapPreview.Status);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_CallsHttpClientGetAsync_WithCorrectUrl()
		{
			// Arrange
			var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
			var mapLocations = new Dictionary<string, MapClassification>
			{
				["install-path"] = MapClassification.User
			};
			mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(mapLocations);

			var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>();
			var mockMapInstallPackage = new Mock<IReadWritePackage>();
			mockMapInstallPackage.Setup(p => p.GetType()).Returns(typeof(IReadWritePackage));

			var mapPreview = new MapPreview(
				"test-uid",
				mockModData.Object,
				mockCache.Object,
				MapStatus.DownloadAvailable,
				MapClassification.User,
				null,
				null);

			var mockHttpMessageHandler = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
			mockHttpMessageHandler
				.Protected()
				.Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>("SendAsync", ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Content = new Mock<HttpContent>().Object
				});

			var mockHttpClient = new HttpClient(mockHttpMessageHandler.Object);
			var httpClientFactoryMock = new Mock<HttpClientFactory>();
			httpClientFactoryMock.Setup(() => HttpClientFactory.Create()).Returns(mockHttpClient);

			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockHttpClient;

			try
			{
				// Act
				await mapPreview.Install("http://test-repo/");

				// Assert
				mockHttpMessageHandler.Protected()
					.Verify("SendAsync", Times.Once(),
						ItExpr.Is<HttpRequestMessage>(req => 
							req.RequestUri.ToString() == "http://test-repo/test-uid" &&
							req.Method == HttpMethod.Get),
						ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>());
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_SetsDownloadError_OnHttpFailure()
		{
			// Arrange
			var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
			var mapLocations = new Dictionary<string, MapClassification>
			{
				["install-path"] = MapClassification.User
			};
			mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(mapLocations);

			var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>();
			var mapPreview = new MapPreview(
				"test-uid",
				mockModData.Object,
				mockCache.Object,
				MapStatus.DownloadAvailable,
				MapClassification.User,
				null,
				null);

			var mockHttpMessageHandler = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
			mockHttpMessageHandler
				.Protected()
				.Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>("SendAsync", ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.NotFound));

			var mockHttpClient = new HttpClient(mockHttpMessageHandler.Object);
			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockHttpClient;

			try
			{
				// Act
				await mapPreview.Install("http://test-repo/");

				// Assert
				Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, mapPreview.Status);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}
	}
}

			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockClient;

			try

				var mockPackage = new Mock<IReadWritePackage>(MockBehavior.Strict);
				var mapLocations = new Dictionary<IReadOnlyPackage, MapClassification>

				mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(mapLocations);

				var mapPreview = CreateMapPreview(mockModData.Object, mockCache.Object, MapStatus.DownloadAvailable);

				Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, mapPreview.Status);

			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}

		private static MapPreview CreateMapPreview(ModData modData, MapCache cache, MapStatus status)
		{
			// Use reflection to create MapPreview with controlled initial status
			var mapPreview = new MapPreview("test-uid", modData, cache);
			
			// Set status via reflection since it's in volatile InnerData
			var innerDataField = typeof(MapPreview).GetField("innerData", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			var innerData = (dynamic)innerDataField.GetValue(mapPreview);
			innerData.Status = status;

			return mapPreview;
		}
	}

	{
		private static MapPreview CreateMapPreview(ModData modData, MapCache cache, MapStatus status)
		{
			// Find the actual constructor via reflection
			var ctor = typeof(MapPreview).GetConstructor(new[] { typeof(string), typeof(ModData), typeof(MapCache) });
			if (ctor == null)
				throw new InvalidOperationException("MapPreview constructor not found");

			var mapPreview = (MapPreview)ctor.Invoke(new object[] { "test-uid", modData, cache });

			// Set initial status via reflection (innerData is volatile/private)
			var innerDataField = typeof(MapPreview).GetField("innerData", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
			if (innerDataField == null)
				throw new InvalidOperationException("innerData field not found");

			var innerData = (dynamic)innerDataField.GetValue(mapPreview);
			innerData.Status = status;

			return mapPreview;
		}

		[Fact]
		public void Install_DoesNotDownload_WhenStatusInvalid()
		{
			var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
			var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>();
			mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(new Dictionary<IReadOnlyPackage, MapClassification>());

			var mapPreview = CreateMapPreview(mockModData.Object, mockCache.Object, MapStatus.Available);

			mapPreview.Install("http://test/");

			Assert.Equal(MapStatus.Available, mapPreview.Status);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void Install_SetsDownloadError_WhenNoUserInstallLocation()
		{
			var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
			mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(new Dictionary<IReadOnlyPackage, MapClassification>());

			var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>();
			var mapPreview = CreateMapPreview(mockModData.Object, mockCache.Object, MapStatus.DownloadAvailable);

		{

			mockHttpHandler.Protected()
				.Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>("SendAsync", ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Content = new StringContent("test")
				});

			var mockClient = new HttpClient(mockHttpHandler.Object);

			// Replace the static HttpClientFactory.Create via reflection
			var createMethod = typeof(HttpClientFactory).GetMethod("Create", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static);
			var originalCreate = createMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<HttpClient>)) as Func<HttpClient>;
			var replaceField = typeof(HttpClientFactory).GetField("create", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);
			
			replaceField.SetValue(null, () => mockClient);

			try
			{
				var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
				var mockPackage = new Mock<IReadWritePackage>();
				var mapLocations = new Dictionary<IReadOnlyPackage, MapClassification>

				var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>();
				var mapPreview = CreateMapPreview(mockModData.Object, mockCache.Object, MapStatus.DownloadAvailable);

				mapPreview.Install("http://test-repo/");

				mockHttpHandler.Protected()
					.Verify("SendAsync", Times.Once(),
						ItExpr.Is<HttpRequestMessage>(req =>
							req.RequestUri.ToString() == "http://test-repo/test-uid" &&
							req.Method == HttpMethod.Get),
						ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>());

			finally
			{
				// Restore original
				replaceField.SetValue(null, originalCreate);
			}
		}

		public void Install_SetsDownloadError_OnHttpFailure()
		{
			var mockHttpHandler = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
			mockHttpHandler.Protected()
				.Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>("SendAsync", ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.NotFound));

			var mockClient = new HttpClient(mockHttpHandler.Object);

			var createMethod = typeof(HttpClientFactory).GetMethod("Create", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static);
			var replaceField = typeof(HttpClientFactory).GetField("create", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);
			replaceField.SetValue(null, () => mockClient);

			try
			{
				var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
				var mockPackage = new Mock<IReadWritePackage>();
				var mapLocations = new Dictionary<IReadOnlyPackage, MapClassification>
				{
					[mockPackage.Object] = MapClassification.User
				};
				mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(mapLocations);

				var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>();
				var mapPreview = CreateMapPreview(mockModData.Object, mockCache.Object, MapStatus.DownloadAvailable);

				mapPreview.Install("http://test/");

				Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, mapPreview.Status);
			}
			finally
